portInfo.description: UNESCO (ID 826) describes the Ligurian coast between Cinque Terre and Portovenere as a scenic cultural landscape of terraced towns. That is the excursion product; La Spezia itself is the logistics hub.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: La Spezia Cruise Terminal — La Spezia waterfront cruise terminal area

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: One or two Cinque Terre villages by rail
La Spezia centre only if trains fail timing
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Buy return rail capacity early; do not hike the Sentiero Azzurro without a timed exit plan.
